preamble: Documentary photography, available light only, handheld 35mm. Natural skin tones, honest imperfect surfaces, slight motion in the frame. Muted realistic grade, no colour cast, visible grain. Candid, unposed, nobody looking at camera. Absolutely not stock-photo styling, no fake smiles, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: Ordinary apartment kitchen, the cabinet doors under the sink wide open, a plastic basin on the cabinet floor catching drips from a leaking siphon, a wet rag beside it, a few kitchen items moved out onto the floor. Camera at knee height, wide shot. Soft daylight from a window on the right. The open cabinet and basin sit in the right half of the frame; the left third of the frame is a plain kitchen wall and plain floor with nothing on it, large empty space for text. No people, no text, no signs, no logos, no brand names on packaging.
